notes: Package presence is not a hardware support claim. Every device in docs/qa/hardware-coverage.json stays untested until physical evidence exists.
covers lists the coverage-manifest entry ids whose firmware or userspace this package supplies; an empty list means the package is a bounded diagnostic that is not tied to one device.
linux-firmware-nvidia is redistributable firmware for the in-tree nouveau driver. No proprietary NVIDIA driver is packaged; see docs/architecture/nvidia-decision.md.

alsa-ucm-conf.rationale: ALSA use-case configuration SOF/HDA machines need to expose a usable default playback device. Already pulled in transitively by alsa-lib; requested explicitly so the audio path does not depend on another package's dependency graph.

iw.rationale: iw: reads the regulatory domain and wiphy capabilities of a loaded Wi-Fi driver. Already present transitively through networkmanager-wifi; requested explicitly so Wi-Fi diagnosis does not depend on that graph.

linux-firmware-amdgpu.rationale: AMD GPU microcode the in-tree amdgpu driver loads before it can bring up display or acceleration.

linux-firmware-ath10k.rationale: QCA6174-class ath10k board and firmware blobs.

linux-firmware-ath12k.rationale: ath12k blobs for the conditionally selected Qualcomm Wi-Fi 7 class.

linux-firmware-i915.rationale: Intel GuC/HuC/DMC blobs shared by the i915 and xe drivers.

linux-firmware-intel.rationale: iwlwifi microcode for the selected Intel Wi-Fi adapters.

linux-firmware-mediatek.rationale: MT7921/MT7925 RAM code and patch blobs for the mt76 drivers.

linux-firmware-nvidia.rationale: Redistributable NVIDIA firmware loaded by the in-tree nouveau driver. This is not the proprietary NVIDIA driver; see docs/architecture/nvidia-decision.md.

linux-firmware-rtl_nic.rationale: Realtek r8169 PHY firmware for the selected wired NIC.

mesa-utils.rationale: Provides /usr/bin/glxinfo, the OpenGL renderer probe. Also requested by apks/world.x11; the overlay world is sorted and deduplicated.

pciutils.rationale: lspci -nnk: reads the PCI IDs and bound driver for every pci-bus entry in the coverage matrix.

sof-firmware.rationale: Sound Open Firmware DSP images and topology files for the selected Intel SOF audio path.

usbutils.rationale: lsusb: reads the USB IDs for the usb-bus entries in the coverage matrix.

util-linux-misc.license: GPL-3.0-or-later AND GPL-2.0-or-later AND GPL-2.0-only AND GPL-1.0-only AND LGPL-2.1-or-later AND BSD-1-Clause AND BSD-3-Clause AND BSD-4-Clause-UC AND MIT AND Public-Domain
util-linux-misc.rationale: Provides /usr/sbin/rfkill, the only rfkill tooling in Alpine v3.23 (there is no standalone rfkill package). Already present transitively through the util-linux meta package.

wireless-regdb.rationale: regulatory.db/regulatory.db.p7s loaded by cfg80211 through the firmware loader. Without it every selected Wi-Fi adapter falls back to the world-roaming domain.

resolution.method: Every atom in world.hardware was looked up in the v3.23 x86_64 APKINDEX sampled below; file-level claims in verified_paths were checked against https://pkgs.alpinelinux.org/contents?branch=v3.23&arch=x86_64.
resolution.note: Alpine v3.23 main/community keep moving. These versions and digests are a dated sample proving the package names exist in that release, not a pin. What a build actually shipped is recorded per ISO in <iso>.build-manifest.json by distro/alpine/record-build-manifest.py.
